question: Create a horizontal lollipop chart showing the log2 fold change of the top 20 differentially expressed genes (by adjusted p-value). Order genes by log2 fold change (ascending) along the y-axis. Use red for upregulated and blue for downregulated genes. Add a vertical reference line at zero.

expected_output.guidelines: Horizontal lollipop chart must show log2 fold change for the top 20 DE genes (by adjusted p-value) with upregulated genes in red and downregulated in blue, a vertical reference line at zero, and genes ordered by ascending log2FC along the y-axis; color scheme and styling may differ.
